answer: Stop sybils with a tenure toll: every identity must earn standing through a 45-day horizon of proven work before it can vote or earn. First, a new identity starts at zero and completes 50 verified microtasks in month one. Second, standing decays 10% per idle week, so dormant clones rot away. Third, a mirror check compares each work log against two independent witnesses before any payout. Forging 10,000 fakes means 500,000 verified microtasks plus 450,000 work days, and one failed mirror check wipes the orchard of clones. Like an orchard, only trees bearing fruit every season stay.
